Norddjurs is a Danish municipality referenced in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Program (RKKP) [^src1]. It is included in the detailed geographical breakdown of Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke through anticoagulant treatment among patients with atrial fibrillation [^src1]. The data for this indicator is derived from DanStroke and the National Patient Registry (LPR), serving as a vital tool for local quality development and benchmarking across all 98 Danish municipalities [^src1]. 

Because the available corpus contains only a single statistical entry for Norddjurs, there are no specific claims, relationships, or timeline events associated with it, and no related entities are linked in this dataset.
